hero.title: Product Definition, Design & Development
hero.subtitle: Eldar Visual works with businesses, organizations, and nonprofits from product definition and user experience, through UX/UI design, to the development of websites, Web applications, and mobile apps.
hero.tags: Thoughtful UX/UI | Fast, Reliable Development | Built to Scale

items.title: Mobile App Development (React Native)
items.desc: Native app development for iOS and Android from a single codebase. We focus on offline-first architecture and high performance for enterprises and startups.

items.title: Web & SaaS Development
items.desc: Complex systems and web applications built to scale. We utilize Next.js and React to ensure maximum security and performance.

items.title: UX/UI Design
items.desc: Precise interfaces that reduce friction and increase conversions. We design data-driven user journeys based on business understanding.

items.title: Website Modernization
items.desc: Migrating outdated systems to modern architecture. Improving speed, security, and maintainability without losing SEO history.

items.title: Management, Maintenance & Security
items.desc: Webmaster services for organizations that need stable, reliable infrastructure. We handle performance monitoring, security updates, and ongoing digital infrastructure management.

items.title: E-Commerce Development
items.desc: Fast and secure e-commerce infrastructures. Emphasis on frictionless checkout experiences and reliable inventory management.

process.subtitle: Workflow
process.title: From Architecture to
process.step1_desc: Comprehensive performance and UX audit. We map out bottlenecks, analyze the market, and deliver a clear development roadmap.
process.step2_desc: Interface planning and precise prototyping, ensuring an intuitive, frictionless user experience.
process.step3_desc: Clean, modular development using Next.js and React Native. Cross-platform solutions emphasizing speed and industrial-grade stability.
process.step4_desc: Cloud deployment accompanied by load testing and continuous monitoring to optimize performance and conversion rates.
